note: Deep-review corpus for the a2ui-protocol-facts knowledge pack. Positives: imperative / diagnostic / symptom phrasings of wire-protocol + renderer-mechanics asks across the six axes (lifecycle, bindings, lists, actions/input, functions/checks, errors/versions). Negatives drawn adversarially from the dangerous near-neighbors: a2ui-composer (compose a payload), a2ui-builder (build renderer/catalog source), a2ui-reviewer (grade), and the future sibling packs a2ui-catalog-facts / a2ui-training-facts / a2ui-chat-agent-facts; plus generic component/design neighbors. n90 added 2026-07-26 (issue #106): validate-then-stream fenced to a2ui-chat-agent-facts.
